1.name: public PoC exists — detection stage only

modules.title: Array.prototype.slice fastSlice TOCTOU → OOB read (addrof oracle)
modules.oracle: isVulnerable() returns true: the OOB slot holds a valid JSObject pointer, so addrof works. Clean NaN = patched.
modules.affected: Safari before 9.1.2, iOS before 9.3.3, tvOS before 9.2.2 (2016)
modules.fixed: WebKit Jul 2016 — every engine released since 2017 is unaffected

modules.title: JSArray::unshiftCountWithArrayStorage OOB clear (splice)
modules.oracle: renderer/process crash (crash oracle) on vulnerable engines; clean exit = patched
modules.affected: WebKit before Dec 2018 fixes (Safari 12.1.1/12.0.2; iOS 12.1.2/12.0.3; PS4 < 7.00; Switch 2.1.0 webkit)
modules.fixed: WebKit bug 187450, Jan 2019 — modern engines are not affected

modules.title: DFG compileNewArrayWithSpread integer overflow → oversized butterfly
modules.oracle: allocated butterfly is orders of magnitude smaller than the reported array length → the mismatch the OOB read/write relies on is present.

modules.title: DFG INT_MIN bounds-check-elimination OOB write (ArithAbs/Math.abs)
modules.oracle: addrof / fakeobj from the length-corruption primitive (no code execution)
modules.affected: WebKit before the iOS 13.4.x / Safari 13.1 era (2020)
modules.fixed: Apple 13.4.x updates, 2020 — modern engines are not affected

modules.title: PopStateEvent use-after-free → object address leak
modules.category: JIT-free runtime bug / UAF info leak
modules.oracle: a setTimeout callback receives a value that decodes to a live JSObject pointer (tagged 0x0002xxxxxxxxxxxx pattern) instead of the double it was passed
modules.affected: Safari < 15.4, iOS/iPadOS < 15.3.1, macOS < 12.2.1; PoC runs on webkitgtk-2.34.3

modules.title: structured-clone Map/Date use-after-free (crash oracle)
modules.oracle: renderer death mid-run (crash oracle) → vulnerable. All clones walked without touching freed memory → patched.

modules.title: JSC structure confusion via accessor/plain-polymorphic read
modules.oracle: get_getterSetter() hands back the accessor where the primitive belongs — a structure confusion, observable as a typeof mismatch

modules.title: ANGLE Metal staging buffer out-of-bounds write (depth textures)
modules.oracle: trigger completes silently on an ANGLE-Metal device → vulnerable-class; renderer/GPU crash (crash oracle) → vulnerable
modules.affected: iOS Safari < 26.2; Chrome < 143.0.7499.110; ANGLE commit 95a32cb fixes

modules.title: WebGL capability validation OOB write (PRIMITIVE_RESTART_FIXED_INDEX)
modules.oracle: gl.enable(0x8D69) on a WebGL1 context returns NO_ERROR → the dangerous capability path is live. A GL_INVALID_ENUM = patched.
modules.fixed: Safari 18.3.1 / iOS 18.3.2 / macOS 15.3.2 (supplementary fix for an attack blocked in iOS 17.2)

modules.title: WebKit DFG JIT use-after-free (StoreBarrierInsertionPhase)
modules.oracle: addrof / fakeobj from the reclaimed butterfly (no code execution)

modules.title: Navigation API canIntercept cross-origin gate (SOP bypass)
modules.category: security policy / Same Origin Policy bypass
modules.oracle: NavigateEvent.canIntercept === true for a same-site/cross-origin target

modules.title: RegExp JIT lastIndex side-effect type confusion (value divergence)
modules.oracle: a lastIndex callback that mutates the regexp changes the match outcome in the compiled tier but not the interpreter: the side-effect-free assumption is broken
modules.fixed: WebKit 2018 — regexp match no longer treated as side-effect-free

modules.title: DFG for…in / in-operator type confusion (constant-folded enumerator)
modules.oracle: optimized-code result divergence from interpreter ground truth (mismatch oracle)
modules.source: public root-cause analysis (blog.pksecurity.io) — probe is RECONSTRUCTED from it, not the verbatim reproducer

modules.title: DFG tryGetConstantProperty TOCTOU race (stale cell)
modules.severity: critical (exploited ITW by the Coruna kit)
modules.oracle: stale-cell detection via result-divergence oracle + crash oracle
modules.affected: iOS 16.6–17.2.1 ITW; WebKit before the iOS 17.3 fix; WebKitGTK before 2.39.x
modules.source: https://github.com/FuzzySecurity/Cassowary-CVE-2024-23222-x86_64 (published race shape; module is a reconstructed probe)
